sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This SOP covers cold chain handling at the Delhi warehouse, site code DEL-01. This procedure applies to all shifts, contract staff and visiting carrier drivers. Deviations must be approved in writing by the site operations manager.

sections.heading: Temperature range
sections.text: Chilled pharmaceutical pallets at Delhi (DEL-01) must be held between 3 and 6 degrees Celsius from receipt until dispatch.

sections.heading: Excursion response
sections.text: If a data logger records a temperature excursion longer than 15 minutes, the shift lead quarantines the pallet and raises a quality hold.

sections.heading: Reefer pre-cooling
sections.text: Reefer trailers must be pre-cooled for at least 20 minutes before loading starts.

sections.heading: Records
sections.text: Every step is logged in the warehouse management system with the user ID and timestamp. Paper records are scanned and kept for three years.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This SOP covers customer returns processing at the Delhi warehouse, site code DEL-01. This procedure applies to all shifts, contract staff and visiting carrier drivers. Deviations must be approved in writing by the site operations manager.

sections.heading: Return window
sections.text: Customer returns are accepted at Delhi (DEL-01) up to 14 days after delivery when the original packing slip is present.

sections.heading: Grading
sections.text: Returned units are graded A, B or C within 72 hours of arrival, and grade C units are moved to the liquidation cage.

sections.heading: Refund release
sections.text: Refunds are released once the returned item is scanned into returns bay R1.

sections.heading: Records
sections.text: Every step is logged in the warehouse management system with the user ID and timestamp. Paper records are scanned and kept for three years.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This SOP covers hazardous materials storage at the Delhi warehouse, site code DEL-01. This procedure applies to all shifts, contract staff and visiting carrier drivers. Deviations must be approved in writing by the site operations manager.

sections.heading: Flammable liquid limits
sections.text: Class 3 flammable liquids are limited to 500 litres per rack bay at Delhi (DEL-01).

sections.heading: Spill kit inspection
sections.text: Spill kits next to the hazmat cage are inspected every 7 days and the seal number is recorded.

sections.heading: Segregation distance
sections.text: Flammable liquids are stored at least 6 metres away from oxidisers.

sections.heading: Records
sections.text: Every step is logged in the warehouse management system with the user ID and timestamp. Paper records are scanned and kept for three years.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This SOP covers carrier damage claims at the Delhi warehouse, site code DEL-01. This procedure applies to all shifts, contract staff and visiting carrier drivers. Deviations must be approved in writing by the site operations manager.

sections.heading: Filing deadline
sections.text: Damage claims must be filed with the carrier within 5 days of delivery at Delhi (DEL-01).

sections.heading: Photo evidence
sections.text: Each claim needs at least 6 photos showing the outer packaging, the label and the damaged item.

sections.heading: Approval threshold
sections.text: Claims above INR 75,000 need approval from the regional finance controller before submission.

sections.heading: Records
sections.text: Every step is logged in the warehouse management system with the user ID and timestamp. Paper records are scanned and kept for three years.

sections.heading: Scope

sections.text: Inbound carriers must book a dock slot at Delhi (DEL-01) at least 12 hours in advance.

sections.heading: Late arrivals
sections.text: Carriers arriving more than 45 minutes late are moved to the next free slot.

sections.heading: Detention charges
sections.text: Detention charges start after 2 free hours at the dock.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This SOP covers cycle counting at the Delhi warehouse, site code DEL-01. This procedure applies to all shifts, contract staff and visiting carrier drivers. Deviations must be approved in writing by the site operations manager.

sections.heading: Count frequency
sections.text: A-class SKUs at Delhi (DEL-01) are cycle counted every 30 days.

sections.heading: Variance tolerance
sections.text: A count variance above 1 percent of the system quantity triggers a recount.

sections.heading: Recount owner
sections.text: Recounts are done by a second counter from the inventory control team, never the original counter.

sections.heading: Records
sections.text: Every step is logged in the warehouse management system with the user ID and timestamp. Paper records are scanned and kept for three years.
